item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes and staffs an advisory commission and assigns it study and recommendation functions; these are internal organizational and advisory actions rather than changes to substantive legal rights.","evidence":"There is established the National Commission on America's Urban Families"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The provision itself gives Commission members an entitlement to authorized travel expenses and sets the Executive Director’s compensation ceiling, creating present compensation consequences subject only to administration.","evidence":"they shall be entitled to travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence"}]}
